snippet.title: Banker Simulator Early Access Trailer
snippet.description:
Banker Simulator is a single-player game where you revive a bankrupt bank. With active and passive (idle) gameplay, make strategic decisions to grow your bank, satisfy customers, and tackle financial crises.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3393240/Banker_Simulator/
